subject.why: The red X, shovel, palm tree, and peeking gold coin are clearly depicted.

category.why: The sand mound dominates the lower half rather than appearing as a simple ground strip.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: Palm fronds crowd the top and left edges, lacking clear margins.

colour.why: Bright, saturated palette with good contrast against the blue sky.

detail.why: Clean shapes and smooth volumes without noisy micro-details.

style.why: Matches the chunky, satin 3D render style of the references.

fix: Scale down the composition slightly to provide breathing room along the top and left edges, and flatten the ground into a simpler bottom strip.
